scientific_goal: Determine whether direct transition autocovariance calibration of POD modes 1 through 3 improves the deficient temporal spectrum of the best amplitude-calibrated 0p10 Neural SDE without losing its accurate energy and POD covariance.
scientific_constraints: Start every matched arm from runs/comparison/neural_sde_0p10_r20_velocity_endpoint_moments_h100_200_500_m30/best.pt; do not change architecture, data split, normalization, lag, full diffusion, structured SPSD drift, or the saved 5 percent trimming rule.
Tune and select only on validation repetitions 13 and 14; keep test repetitions 15 and 16 locked.
The lagged-covariance objective targets only shared-POD modes 1 through 3 and excludes the spatial mean.
Treat energy, per-mode amplitude, covariance, PSD, ACF, spatial-mean behavior, rollout survival, and one-step NLL as separate evidence.
The lagged-covariance auxiliary gradient is routed only to drift parameters. The ordinary one-step likelihood retains its normal joint gradients.
Run matched one-step, lagged-covariance-only, endpoint-moment-only, and combined arms before adaptive tuning.
After the matched arms, change one of lagged-covariance weight, moment weights, horizon set, or learning rate at a time. Do not add multistep likelihood in this study.
advisor_guidance: The parent has excellent marginal amplitude on the current validation rollout: about 1.00 times untrimmed energy, 1.08 times POD covariance trace, and 0.156 relative POD covariance error. Its remaining weakness is temporal: the POD-only PSD error is about 0.526 decades, while spatial-mean variance is about 1.54 times reference. First determine whether direct normalized start-to-endpoint covariance matching at horizons 25, 50, 100, 150, and 200 improves POD-mode PSD and ACF without moving energy or covariance away from one. Prefer the smallest useful lagged-covariance weight. Do not interpret a lower auxiliary loss alone as success, and do not use the locked test split for selection.

seed_runs.hypothesis: The parent already matches marginal POD amplitude well but leaves substantial POD temporal-spectrum error for lagged covariance to target.

initial_trials.hypothesis: An additional matched epoch of one-step likelihood alone does not specifically repair the POD temporal spectrum.
initial_trials.expected_observation: One-step NLL may improve, but POD-mode PSD and ACF remain close to the parent.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Direct mode-1-through-3 transition autocovariance matching corrects their decay and oscillation time scales more directly than another one-step continuation.
initial_trials.expected_observation: POD-mode PSD and ACF improve while energy and covariance remain acceptably close to the parent.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Endpoint mean and variance matching at the new horizon grid preserves amplitude but does not directly fix temporal correlation.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Energy and covariance remain good, with less POD PSD or ACF improvement than the lagged-covariance arms.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Combining a small lagged-covariance term with the established endpoint moments improves temporal structure while anchoring marginal amplitude.
initial_trials.expected_observation: This arm gives the best balance of POD PSD and ACF improvement with energy and covariance retained near reference.
